_comment: Old artist-page ids that were merged into another artist or removed outright (bad attribution, not a real artist, duplicate spelling, etc). On every rebuild, 06-build-site.py writes a static forwarding page at the OLD address (canonical link + instant meta-refresh, like write_moved_stub for recording addresses) so the URL returns 200 and search engines see a redirect instead of finding a 404. Key: the old id (a former data/people.json id). Value: the id to forward to, or null to forward to the artist index (/artists/) when there is no replacement page.
